<notes>
The single rollout (base1) succeeded: the agent made one LLM call asking for manual divisibility checking, the LLM correctly identified three numbers divisible by 7 (-854, 966, 805), and returned the correct answer "3 numbers are divisible by 7".

This is not a divergence (no disagreement across runs), not a repeated failure (the run succeeded), and the risk of LLM error is speculative—not visible in any trajectory moment. The instruction is clear: "Do not fix what the runs already got right" and "Every edit must trace to a moment in a trajectory. For each one ask: which run did what, and would this text have changed it? If you cannot name the moment, the edit is speculation."

There is no moment of failure or divergence to address. The current harness worked correctly for this task.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
